title: Concupiscible
summary: CONCUPISCIBLE, adjective Exciting or impelling to the enjoyment of carnal pleasure; inclining to the attainment of pleasure or good; as concupiscible appetite.

inlines.v: CONCUPISCIBLE, adjective Exciting or impelling to the enjoyment of carnal pleasure; inclining to the attainment of pleasure or good; as concupiscible appetite.
